workarounds.note: the affiliation marks in the title band are the characters ¹ ² ³, because design text prints plain text and ^1^ would appear as written (gotcha design-text-no-inline-marks); they are the only superscript figures in Latin-1, so the poster stops at three affiliations
the headline −4.2 °C is written **bold** inside the 'stat' paragraph style, which prints it in Bitter 700: 1.4.1 paragraph styles have no fontWeight
col() writes each colour's hex beside its paletteId, because 1.4.1 does not apply colorPalette to the band's design elements (gotcha palette-skips-designs)
bodyText.italicColor is restated in ink: the italic journal titles of the 'refs' paragraph style take it, and without it they print in main-color green (gotcha style-italic-colour)
bodyText.boldColor is restated in ink: each panel copies it for its bold lead-ins, and the :ref labels fall back to it; without it they print in main-color green
design text lineHeight is a multiple of the size (1.2, and 1 for the title): a pt() value silently drops the band's reserved height in 1.4.1 (gotcha design-lineheight-multiple)

the H1 breakBefore is restated because any headings object drops it (gotcha headings-drop-h1-break). The file holds one poster, so the restatement changes nothing on this page; a second H1 would start a page of its own

a :::space{lines=0.33} opens 3.5 mm between the key's :::columns group and Figure 2 in the Results panel: the group leaves no margin, and a figure set inside a box adds none of its own (gotcha box-embed-no-gap)
the copy is worded so that each (Fig. n) sits mid-line: in the ragged panels 1.4.1 ended a line on the '(' before a :ref (gotcha ragged-run-punctuation)
figures and units are copy-fitted so that no pair such as 15 °C breaks at a line end: 1.4.1 breaks at a no-break space as at any other (gotcha nbsp-breaks)
ragged paragraphs that ended on a single word in either edition were reworded, since 1.4.1 applies no runt protection to ragged text (gotcha ragged-runts)

a :::space{lines=0.75} opens 10.8 mm between the references' :::paragraphs group and the acknowledgement, near the 10.6 mm between the other paragraphs of a panel: in 1.4.1 a paragraph after a :::paragraphs container gets the style's spaceBetween (8 pt, 2.8 mm) instead of the body's paragraph spacing (30 pt in the panels)

what.en: The plan of the street, the heat map, the bar chart and the School of Geography's mark, drawn in code from synthetic data in the poster's palette
what.es: El plano de la calle, el mapa de calor, el gráfico de barras y la marca del Departamento de Geografía, dibujados en código con datos sintéticos y la paleta del póster
